Our story on LinkedIn ↗

We’re Qodvexa Technologies.
Your ideas, engineered for the real world.

Founded in 2024 and based in Indore, Madhya Pradesh, Qodvexa Technologies Private Limited helps startups, small businesses, and growing enterprises digitize their operations.

We develop custom web applications, SaaS platforms, and AI-integrated tools, alongside websites, mobile applications, and CRM/ERP solutions. Our focus is practical software that simplifies work and supports better decisions.

Our portfolio brings that purpose to life: assessment-led healthcare journeys, product discovery for retail, clear school information for parents, and credible business websites. Each experience starts with what a visitor needs to understand, do, or decide.

06 / BEFORE WE BEGIN

A few things
you might be wondering.

Every good project starts with a useful conversation.

What can we build together?+

Business websites, e-commerce experiences, mobile and web applications, SaaS platforms, CRM/ERP systems, and AI-enabled workflows. We’ll define the right scope around your requirements.

Can you redesign an existing website?+

Yes. Share your current website, the parts that aren’t working well, and your business goals. We can discuss the structure, user experience, content, and development changes it needs.

How are cost and timelines decided?+

They depend on the scope, integrations, content readiness, and complexity. After a requirements discussion, the proposal can set out deliverables, milestones, and review points.

What should I share to get started?+

A short description of your business, the problem you want to solve, required features, reference experiences, and your preferred timeframe. Existing branding and content are helpful too.
